title: Attempt Retry for Card Retrieval Post-Issuance
description: This test ensures that retrying card retrieval after freshly issuing a card results in a new invocation of the card details query, with correct state transition and messaging. Automation: HIGH — API and UI control with retry action.
testDescription: A user, seeing a 'no card found' state right after card order, selects 'Try Again'. The app must re-query card details and respond based on the new server response, enforcing the dynamic no-cards flow.

expectedResult: Each retry triggers a new card details fetch. If response remains HTTP 203/ID=31, the same no-card message and retry option are shown again. If card is found, the user proceeds to the privacy/warning enforcement screen.

title: Attempt Counter Resets After Block Duration
description: This test verifies that after the block period of 10 minutes has elapsed, the attempt counter for OTP entry or code requests resets to allow the user to try again. It covers regulatory-mandated authentication flow recovery after lockout, protecting against abuse but ensuring usability. Automation: HIGH – timer, API, and UI assertions.
testDescription: A user is blocked after exceeding the allowed number of OTP requests or incorrect codes. After the mandated 10 minutes waiting period, the attempt counter must reset, allowing the user to retry authentication and view card details. This test is integral to balancing security (abuse suppression) with usability (timely recovery), ensuring compliance with banking standards.
prerequisites: User is currently blocked from viewing card details due to excessive OTP requests or wrong codes, block timer is active, block event log exists, session persists across browser/app closure.
stepsToPerform:
1. Authenticate as test user.
2. Initiate card detail retrieval flow and intentionally trigger block state by exceeding allowed OTP requests or code attempts (e.g., 6 incorrect codes).
3. Observe blockscreen with exact wording 'יש להמתין 10 דקות ולנסות שוב'.
4. Close browser/app and reopen to confirm block persists.
5. Wait exactly 10 minutes from block time (simulate timer if necessary).
6. Re-initiate card detail retrieval process after 10 minutes.
7. Attempt new OTP request or enter correct code.
8. Confirm that blockscreen does NOT appear, attempt counter is reset.
9. Complete authentication flow successfully.
10. Verify that prior block event is logged and cleared.
11. Perform negative test: try again at 9:59 – blockscreen should persist.
12. Remove test user/session after test.
expectedResult: After 10 minutes, blockscreen is cleared and user can try again. Attempt counter is reset. Exact block wording appears during block, disappears after expiry. System logs show block resolution; no further block on retry until new limit is exceeded.
